summary: Two material issues remain: stale committed build artifacts and incorrect timezone handling in the historical analysis.

findings.evidence: The package declares 0.2.40, but dist/server.meta.json:6 still declares 0.2.39 and dist/server.js contains neither tick recognition nor refusal handling. The plan requires an updated build, and .github/workflows/check.yml:27–28 rebuilds and requires dist to remain clean, so these artifacts cannot satisfy that check.
findings.fix: Rebuild using the repository's pinned bb version and commit the resulting dist artifacts alongside the source change.

findings.evidence: hora_local interprets exhaustion deadlines as Europe/Madrid, but their producer, stranded() in server.ts:3999, formats them with toISOString(), which is UTC. Both agotadas() and filas() use this conversion. A reset logged as 2026-11-04 12:00 therefore becomes 11:00 UTC instead of 12:00 UTC. This can mark exhausted accounts available an hour early and incorrectly classify reset-before-turn cases, affecting options A, B, E, F and G.
findings.fix: Parse deadlines emitted by stranded() as UTC in both extraction paths. Regenerate the affected compressed datasets and analysis, then update the report and plan figures.

coverage: Verified the supplied plan SHA256 and reviewed all 37 changed files, including decoding and inspecting the compressed datasets.

Traced dispatch eligibility, placement, account writes, reservations, queues, rejection cleanup, activity/model persistence, background rescue, after-turn placement, retries, manual selection and rebalance.
Read the added tests and mutation runner without executing them.
Inspected Calor's tick text, send-error handling, retry timing and expiry/account-change checks, plus bb-app 0.48.1 dispatch rejection handling.
Compared committed build artifacts with source changes and CI requirements; reviewed extraction and simulation logic.
limitations: Static review only: no files edited, tests, builds, mutations or simulations run, and no delegation.
Historical totals were not independently recomputed against original logs or transcripts.
Live rejection visibility, cache savings and deployment behavior remain unverified.
